summary: IETF review teams check Internet-Drafts for things like general, security, operations, applications and routing issues as they move toward becoming RFCs. This informational RFC lists requirements for better integrating the tools that assign and track those reviews with the Datatracker, without disrupting how the teams already work.

eli5.summary: Many helpers check a school project before it is finished. This lists what a better sign-up sheet would need so everyone knows who is checking what.
